authoredFrom: BD12. The incoming gate measured `855 unresolved of 2,590 edges` with ZERO edges carrying an external marker (`npx tsx script/m14/incoming-gate.ts bash sh 60`). The marker is now WITHHELD for relative paths (./ ../ .\ ..\) exactly as it already was for unqualified names; kept for absolute/rooted paths (/bin/expr) which a project cannot contain. The ./helper.sh row flips to NOT MARKED and a forbid pins the withdrawn shape.
